title: Agent Teleshko scopes you out

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Good day. I trust everything is going well for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good day. I trust everything is going well for you?

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Any offers of help from your fellow vendors?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Any offers of help from your fellow vendors?

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: It is my business to know. Please give me details.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It is my business to know. Please give me details.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Not too busy for a CorpSec vendor audit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not too busy for a CorpSec vendor audit.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: In this district, I'm more than CorpSec. I'm the law. How about I fine you? What are your takings today?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In this district, I'm more than CorpSec. I'm the law. How about I fine you? What are your takings today?

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: I expect some more respect. Have your takings ready for me to check tomorrow. Consider this a warning.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I expect some more respect. Have your takings ready for me to check tomorrow. Consider this a warning.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: You better watch your tongue. I'll be back tomorrow. You'd better have the information I need ready for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You better watch your tongue. I'll be back tomorrow. You'd better have the information I need ready for me.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: I want you to follow the rules. It's nothing business, it's just personal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I want you to follow the rules. It's nothing business, it's just personal.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: There's only one that matters. No collaboration. No worker co-operatives. No collusion between vendors. All that matters is competition. The only rule is the market must endure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's only one that matters. No collaboration. No worker co-operatives. No collusion between vendors. All that matters is competition. The only rule is the market must endure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You can't just harass me like this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can't just harass me like this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You can't just harass me like this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You can't just harass me like this.

Demeanor is an NPC expression, not a relationship-meter change.
Friend/Business icon meanings come from gameplay; Enemy's UI label is unconfirmed.
Routes stop at this conversation's exit; external dialogue gates are shown separately.
